_why: Skill-candidates row 'an AC count in a paired doc goes stale every time an AC is inserted': three stale 'All N ACs' claims in one feature were each caught by an auditor, not a check. `h_mad_ac_census.py` re-derives the count, checks numbering, and keeps document order advisory because calibration showed audited specs order by topic. These rows prove each rule has a test that bites.

mutations.name: a-stale-claim-is-accepted
mutations._mechanism: The row's defect: 'All 4 ACs' over a five-AC spec reads OK.

mutations.name: gaps-are-not-checked
mutations._mechanism: A missing AC-2.2 between AC-2.1 and AC-2.3 passes.
mutations.find: for missing in sorted(set(range(1, max(nums) + 1)) - nums):

mutations.name: duplicates-are-not-checked
mutations._mechanism: Two AC-2.1 lines count as two ACs and the claim check is fooled.

mutations.name: an-orphan-letter-passes
mutations._mechanism: The row's own case: AC-3.8b with no AC-3.8 reads OK.
mutations.find: if letter and n not in bases.get(fr, set()):

mutations.name: order-moves-the-verdict
mutations._mechanism: Calibration ignored: four audited specs that order ACs by topic all report DRIFT.
mutations.find: findings = numbering_findings(acs) + claim_findings(len(acs), docs) if acs else []
mutations.replace: findings = numbering_findings(acs) + claim_findings(len(acs), docs) + order_advisories(acs) if acs else []

mutations.name: a-tagged-ac-is-missed
mutations._mechanism: `AC-2.1 (layout):` is not parsed, so the count is low and a gap is invented.

mutations.name: no-acs-reads-as-ok
mutations._mechanism: A spec in an unrecognised shape certifies 'All 0 ACs' as consistent.
